title: Claude Code Self-Hosted Environments: Run Sessions on Your Own Infrastructure
description:
Anthropic opened a public beta of self-hosted environments for Claude Code. Session execution moves to machines you provision; model inference stays with Anthropic.
Team and Enterprise plans only, and it ships off by default.

Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments
